summary: Coercing unrecognised values, including None, to a boolean with the bool filter is deprecated.
questions: Which values does the bool filter accept?

answer_card.title: bool filter on invalid values deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: The `bool` filter coercing **unrecognised values** (lists, dicts, `None`, arbitrary strings) is deprecated. Only pass real booleans or recognised boolean strings/numbers, or use an explicit test such as `| length > 0` or `is truthy`.
